profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry and a Bachelor of Science (B.S) from University of California, Irvine. Skilled in Rust, Java, and building scalable distributed systems.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
SDE @ Amazon B2B Payments
- Full-stack development focused on building customer-focused, scalable products for Amazon B2B Payments (B2BP).
- Designed and delivered customer-facing products including:
1. Direct debit as shared payment method in Germany.
2. ACH payment method for Amazon Business checkout in US.
3. Usage of direct debit and ACH for making invoice payments 
4. Enable direct debit and Pay-by-Invoice for Amazon Business Prime
5. [IN PROGRESS] Redesign of development and testing workflows to incorporate accessibility features in B2B Payments-owned UI 

- Product link:
https://www.amazon.com/b2b/info/amazon-business

- Skill & Environment:
JDK 8, API design and development, scalability, AWS (S3, EC2, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda), ReactJS, Linux, CI/CD, Microservices, SOA, NoSQL (DynamoDB), Spring, GIT, Unit testing (Mockito), functional and integration testing (Cucumber), IntelliJ IDEA, Agile, Scrum, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Redux, Perl, Scala

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Utilized Java and Spring framework to develop RESTful microservices as part of ECS's shiny, new AWS platform. 
• Wrote unit tests with Groovy and Spock 
• Collaborated as part of an agile team and working towards helping our organization move towards CI/CD. 
• Previously expanded ECS's legacy platform functionality with C# and .NET

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: • Developed a Windows CRUD application for data entry in the field. Technologies utilized include Javascript, HTML, CSS (and SASS), WinJS, jQuery, and Azure

volunteerExperiences.description:
